notes: Franchise listing site with 24 franchises per page. Pagination uses offset parameter. Each listing includes franchise name, industry category, and investment price range. Detail URLs are in format franchisedetails.asp?FranID=[id] but href attribute extraction not supported by current scraper. Listings can be filtered A-Z by letter parameter or show all with letter= (empty). The site has 'Next' and 'Last' pagination links at the bottom.
